856-4321-5477-8249.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Food.
856-4321-5477-8249.description:
Activate Defiant Salvager by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food, returning Cauldron Familiar to the battlefield from your graveyard.
Cauldron Familiar and Insidious Roots trigger.
Resolve the Insidious Roots trigger, creating a token and a Food token.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Repeat

1580-4446-4871-5670.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is 2 or higher.
1580-4446-4871-5670.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Cleric
1580-4446-4871-5670.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing Reassembling Skeleton.
When Reassembling Skeleton dies, Relic Vial and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Relic Vial trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Reassembling Skeleton by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

4213-4687-4929.notablePrerequisites: Cryptic Trilobite has at least four counters on it.
4213-4687-4929.description:
Activate Hankyu by tapping Gilder Bairn, producing its effect.
Activate Gilder Bairn by paying {2}{G/U} and untapping it, doubling each counter on Cryptic Trilobite.
Activate Cryptic Trilobite as many times as necessary by removing counters from it, adding at least three mana.
Repeat from step 2.
Once you have infinite counters on Cryptic Trilobite, you may instead double the counters on any other permanents.

225-851-1308-6753-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight tapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers.
When the New Planet tokens enter, Stone-Seeder Hierophant triggers eight times
Resolve the first trigger, untapping Stone-Seeder Hierophant.
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping a New Planet.
Repeat from step 3 for the remaining triggers.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat

553-2928-7467.description:
During the opponent's end step immediately before your turn, cast Approach of the Second Sun by paying {6}{W} using Tidal Barracuda.
In response, cast Sudden Setback by paying its mana cost, putting Approach of the Sun on top of your library.
In your draw step, draw Approach of the Second Sun.
Cast Approach of the Second Sun by paying {6}{W}, winning the game.

3240-5477-6462-6797.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Nether Traitor.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Nether Traitor triggers, causing you to pay {B} to return Nether Traitor from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Kheru Goldkeeper and Insidious Roots triggers, creating a Treasure token, a 1/1 Plant creature token and putting a +1/+1 counter on each Plant you control.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

997-5961--5.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to Uncivil Unrest
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat

772-2511-3175.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Sun Titan.
When Sun Titan dies, Shade's Form triggers, returning Sun Titan from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sun Titan enters, it triggers, returning Shade's Form from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Sun Titan.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat.

3941-4331-4993-7356.description:
Activate Coveted Jewel by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Manifold Key's first ability by paying {1} and tapping it, untapping Coveted Jewel.
Activate Drafna's first ability by paying {1}{U}, returning Manifold Key from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Manifold Key by paying {0} due to Longshot.
Longshot triggers, dealing 2 damage to each opponent.
Repeat.

240-4068-5256-5470.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Mountain.
240-4068-5256-5470.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing a player to mill a number of cards equal to the sacrificed creature's power
Repeat from step 2.

uses.n: Heliod, the Radiant Dawn // Heliod, the Warped Eclipse

2421-3705-4668-5231.notablePrerequisites: Opponents have drawn at least one card this turn.
2421-3705-4668-5231.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Squee and Skyfire Phoenix, adding {R}{R}.
Cast Squee from your graveyard by paying {R}{R}.
Skyfire Phoenix triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2511-6972-7159.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Arcbound Tracker.
When Arcbound Tracker dies, its modular ability and persist ability trigger.
Resolve the modular trigger, putting Arcbound Tracker's +1/+1 counters on another artifact creature.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning Arcbound Tracker from your graveyard to the battlefield. It will not have a -1/-1 counter on it due to its modular ability.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

1010-5330-6972.description:
Activate Atog by sacrificing Arcbound Prototype.
When Arcbound Prototype dies, its modular ability and persist ability trigger.
Resolve the modular trigger, putting Arcbound Prototype's +1/+1 counters on another artifact creature.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning Arcbound Prototype from your graveyard to the battlefield. It will not have a -1/-1 counter on it due to its modular ability.
Resolve the Atog ability.
Repeat.

5147-5795-6871-6879.description:
Cast Barkform Harvester by paying {3}.
When Barkform Harvester enters, Haru triggers, targeting Barkform Harvester as it is a land due to Toph.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Barkform Harvester.
When Barkform Harvester dies, Haru triggers, returning Barkform Harvester from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Barkform Harvester enters, Haru triggers, targeting Barkform Harvester as it is a land due to Toph.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat from step 3.

3532-5078-5402-6259.easyPrerequisites: There is a removable counter on a creature you control.
3532-5078-5402-6259.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Captain Storm triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Captain Storm.
Repeat.

1497-1829-5220-6900.description:
Activate Wild Cantor by sacrificing it.
When Wild Cantor dies, Mortuary and Vindictive Vampire trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Wild Cantor from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Vindictive Vampire trigger, dealing 1 damage to each opponent and causing you to gain 1 life.
Cast Wild Cantor from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

339-677-2292-4927.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

2457-4321-4365-5794.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating four tokens.
Activate Baylen's first ability twice by tapping the four tokens, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat.

1825-6745-6760.notablePrerequisites:
Uthros has twelve or more charge counters on it.
Uthros nd up to three other lands you control can collectively tap to produce at least {4}{W}{U}.
Adagia has twelve or more charge counters on it.
1825-6745-6760.description:
Activate Uthros and up to three other lands by paying {U} and tapping them, adding at least {4}{W}{U}.
Activate Adagia by paying {3}{W} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Treachery that is legendary attached to any creature.
If you control two legendary Treachery permanents, put one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
The Treachery token's enter-the-battlefield ability triggers, untapping Adagia, Uthros and up to three other lands.
Repeat.

1563-2457-3499-6753.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Activate the Insects by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat

225-1479-5700-5701-6528.notablePrerequisites:
Stone-Seeder Hierophant does not have summoning sickness.
You are able to play a land this turn.
225-1479-5700-5701-6528.description:
Play Petrified Field.
When Petrified Field enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree, Stone-Seeder Hierophant and Elfsworn Giant trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, putting nothing onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger, untapping it.
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping Petrified Field.
Holding priority, activate Petrified Field's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Echoing Deeps from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Elfsworn Giant trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Echoing Deeps from your hand onto the battlefield as a copy of Petrified Field.
When Echoing Deeps enters the battlefield, Elfsworn Giant and Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger.
Resolve the Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger, untapping it.
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping Echoing Deeps.
Holding priority, activate Echoing Deeps using Petrified Field's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Petrified Field from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Elfsworn Giant trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Petrified Field from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Petrified Field enters the battlefield, Elfsworn Giant and Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger.
Repeat from step 4.

222-527-1849-5147.notablePrerequisites:
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
You control a Saproling.
222-527-1849-5147.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Goblin Bombardment twice by sacrificing Slimefoot and Squee and Selvala.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

225-1170-1645-2397-5954.notablePrerequisites: Stone-Seeder Hierophant does not have summoning sickness.
225-1170-1645-2397-5954.description:
Cast Crown of Flames by paying {R}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
When Overlord of the Hauntwoods enters the battlefield, it triggers twice, creating two tapped Everywhere land tokens.
When the Everywhere land tokens enter the battlefield, Stone-Seeder Hierophant triggers that many times.
Resolve the first trigger, untapping Stone-Seeder Hierophant.
Holding priority, activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping an Everywhere token.
Repeat from step 5 for the remaining trigger.
Resolve the Crown of Flames spell.
Activate the two Everywhere tokens by tapping them, adding {R}{R}.
Activate Crown of Flames by paying {R}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

2921-3558-5220-5683.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Crookshank Kobolds.
When Crookshank Kobolds dies, Mortuary and Remembrance trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Crookshank Kobolds from your graveyard on top of your library.
Resolve the Remembrance trigger, searching your library for Crookshank Kobolds and putting it into your hand.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Crookshank Kobolds by paying {0}.
Repeat.

1621-3908.easyPrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast Spark Double.
1621-3908.description:
Cast Spark Double by paying its mana cost, choosing to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Wispweaver Angel
When Spark Double enters the battlefield, it triggers, blinking Wispweaver Angel.
When Wispweaver Angel enters the battlefield, it triggers, blinking Spark Double. Choose to have Spark Double enter the battlefield as a copy of Wispweaver Angel.
Repeat from step 2.

229-985-5220.description:
Cast Endless One either from your hand or from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Endless One enters the battlefield and dies as a state-based action due to having zero toughness.
Mortuary triggers, putting Endless One on top of your library from your graveyard.
Repeat.

2232-3866-4050.notablePrerequisites: Your devotion to black is at least five.
2232-3866-4050.description:
Cast Abhorrent Overlord by paying {5}{B}{B}.
When Abhorrent Overlord enters the battlefield, it and Cloudstone Curio trigger.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, choosing to return nothing to your hand from the battlefield.
Resolve the Abhorrent Overlord trigger, creating a number of 1/1 Harpy creature tokens equal to your devotion to black.
When the Harpys enter the battlefield, Cloudstone Curio triggers that many times.
Resolve the first Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning Abhorrent Overlord to your hand from the battlefield.
Resolve all remaining Cloudstone Curio triggers, choosing to return nothing to your hand from the battlefield.
Activate Phyrexian Altar seven times by sacrificing seven Harpys, adding {5}{B}{B}.
Repeat.
If your devotion to black excluding Abhorrent Overlord is at least six, this combo will net infinite colored mana.

2034-2308-2999.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
2034-2308-2999.description:
Gain any amount of life.
Trudge Garden triggers, causing you to pay {2} to create a 4/4 Fungus Beast creature token.
When the Fungus Beast enters the battlefield, Impassioned Orator triggers.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Fungus Beast, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Impassioned Orator trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.

1434-1439-3191-3890-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Protean Raider, adding {B}.
When Protean Raider dies, it triggers, causing you to mill six cards and return Unearth and up to one other instant or sorcery card from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Unearth by paying {B}, returning Protean Raider from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Kairi.
Repeat.

1548-4702.notablePrerequisites:
Splinter Twin attached to Port Razer.
Port Razer does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent is unable to block Port Razer.
1548-4702.description:
Activate Port Razer's ability from Splinter Twin by tapping it, creating a token copy of Port Razer with haste.
Declare the newest Port Razer copy as an attacker.
When the token copy of Port Razer deals combat damage to an opponent, it triggers, untapping all your creatures and creating an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat.

141-359.easyPrerequisites: There are legal target(s) for Acrobatic Maneuver.
141-359.description:
Cast Acrobatic Maneuver by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, copying Acrobatic Maneuver, with the copy targeting Naru Meha.
Resolve the copy of Acrobatic Maneuver, blinking Naru Meha.
Repeat from step 3.
